purpose: Extend adaptive Vector Cells with continuous morphing, richer material-graph truth, explicit environmental sensor fusion, and bounded simulation-to-reality discrepancy calibration while reusing the existing Vector Cell, simulation, Paintgun, provenance, and recovery machinery.

properties.fabric: existing Vector Cell Fabric body for vector-state morphing or environmental adaptation
properties.from_state: vector endpoint with observation_scale and optional choice
properties.to_state: vector endpoint with observation_scale and optional choice
properties.material_graph: bounded rich surface graph including metallic, roughness, transmission, IOR, clearcoat, anisotropy, subsurface, normal, displacement and procedural microstructure declarations
properties.thought: Paintgun thought receiving a compiled material graph
properties.object_id: exact Paintgun object id receiving the material graph
properties.readings: explicit externally supplied numeric environmental/sensor readings
properties.policy: sensor-fusion drivers plus from_state/to_state defining the adaptive range
properties.simulation: exact completed simulation receipt for reality comparison or recalibration
properties.observation: external reality observation with source, executor and measured object channel fields
properties.context_key: explicit condition/context binding for calibration evidence

contains: Paintgun-compatible thought and cinematic projection when applicable
explicit approximation boundaries for rich materials
explicit supplied sensor evidence and fusion trace
simulation-reality discrepancies and exact-condition correction evidence
no silent universal generalization from one observation

relationships: continuous morphing operates between exact Paintgun or resolved Vector Cell states rather than replacing Vector Cell identity
compatible shapes interpolate geometry and channels while incompatible topology crossfades rather than claiming impossible deformation
rich material fields remain inspectable even when the current SVG renderer only approximates a subset
environment adaptation fuses explicit supplied readings into one inspectable continuous state factor and never pretends a hardware sensor was sampled
reality feedback is externally supplied evidence that may reopen simulation; one mismatch remains exact-context evidence rather than becoming a universal rule
recorded calibration history is evidence for future simulator-rule design and never becomes authority or hidden self-modification

anatomy_refs.basis: The chameleon fabric accepts two exact visual endpoints and produces a bounded deterministic intermediate state with explicit factor and topology handling.
Morph factor drives continuous visual interpolation/crossfade across a reproducible 0..1 transition.
Rich material properties are normalized as one inspectable graph and compiled into Paintgun-compatible channels plus retained material truth.
Bounded microstructure modes such as fibers, stripes, checker, noise and scales compile deterministically to current renderer approximations while preserving source parameters.
The material graph compiler validates rich material declarations and emits exact Paintgun material/color/skin/light/shade channels plus approximation evidence.
Explicit numeric sensor readings are normalized against declared ranges and retained with their contribution to adaptation.
Multiple explicit readings are fused through declared weights into one continuous adaptation factor that drives the chameleon morph.
Rich materials retain an explicit procedural normal descriptor, while the current SVG generation honestly marks it as metadata rather than claiming full normal-map rendering.
Reality feedback requires an explicit external observation source, executor, measurements and digest-bound comparison against the simulated thought.
The explicit 0..1 factor is the bounded morph weight for every intermediate state.

limitations: continuous compatible geometry interpolation is currently bounded to Paintgun rect/circle/ellipse/polygon shapes; incompatible shapes and changed topology use continuous crossfade

rich material truth exceeds the current SVG renderer: normal, displacement, refraction/IOR, anisotropy and subsurface remain explicit descriptors or bounded visual approximations rather than physically accurate rendering
environment readings are supplied observations; no hardware or browser sensor sampling is claimed
sensor fusion is currently a transparent weighted normalized policy rather than learned hidden control
reality recalibration is first-order numeric exact-condition correction and may still be wrong on the next observation
one or repeated calibration observations are not silently generalized into global simulator laws
persistent_state: state/simulation-calibration.json only when record-calibration is explicitly invoked

truth.basis: Morph endpoints, factor, rich material truth, approximation choices, sensor readings, fusion weights, external observations, discrepancies and calibration evidence all remain inspectable.

agency.basis: Adaptation policy and readings are explicit caller state, and persistent calibration requires an explicit record operation rather than silent learning.

continuity.basis: Vector/Paintgun identity is preserved across compatible morphs; topology changes are represented as bounded crossfades and calibration evidence does not rewrite the live machine body.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The fabric preserves simulation before materialization, distinguishes rich truth from renderer approximation, and lets observed reality reopen the simulator instead of protecting an earlier simulated story.
